title: Seaquel - Fast, Offline SQL Client
summary: An offline-first SQL client for Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server and DuckDB, with visual EXPLAIN plans and drag-and-drop joins.
why: A full SQL workbench that runs from the browser and is free for personal use, with AI assistance kept entirely opt-in.
